def _get_numpy_array_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if use_log_scale:
        log_num1 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num1)

    divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_
    raw_distances = np.abs(_numpy_div(num1 - num2, divisor, replace_inf_with=max_))
    distances = np.minimum(max_, raw_distances)
    distances = np.where(num1 == num2, 0, distances)
    distances = np.where(divisor == 0, max_, distances)
    return distances
